_help: Every licensed photo in this folder needs an entry here. 'id' is how the app finds it: use it in a post's 'photo' field, or name it post-<postId>, activity-<activityId> or avatar-<username> to fill that slot automatically. AI-generated pictures go in photos/ai/ instead and need no entry. See PHOTOS.md.
